description: This file defines the internal class TocTransactionQueue<TService> which extends TransactionQueue and manages transaction queue operations specific to Orleans Transactions with a focus on TOC (Two-Phase Commit) handling. It includes methods for handling local commit operations involving a service and transaction state.

classes.name: TocTransactionQueue<TService>
classes.description: An internal class managing transaction queue operations for Orleans Transactions with a focus on TOC, handling commit operations with a service.

methods.name: TocTransactionQueue
methods.description: Constructor initializing the transaction queue with dependencies such as service, options, resource, storage, clock, logger, timer manager, and activation lifetime.

methods.name: OnLocalCommit
methods.description: Handles local commit of a transaction record by adding a precondition to the storage batch and then invoking the base class's commit handler.
